FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Savory Moments Catering specializes in providing high-quality catering and food preparation services for a variety of events, including corporate meetings, weddings, and private parties. Our core operations focus on delivering customized culinary experiences tailored to the specific needs and preferences of our clients. We maintain strict adherence to local food safety regulations and the FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), ensuring that all ingredients are sourced from reputable suppliers and stored under optimal conditions. Our team is equipped with commercial-grade kitchen facilities, and we implement temperature-controlled transportation for all perishable items, minimizing risks associated with foodborne illnesses. Regular staff training in food safety practices is a priority to maintain compliance and uphold our commitment to providing safe and delicious meals. We also conduct periodic internal audits to ensure the effectiveness of our food safety management system. Through these practices, we aim to deliver exceptional service while prioritizing health and safety standards at every step of our operations.
